svg.aria-label: quantum-cortex v1.1.0, the second edition: what it is, what this edition establishes, the test the system failed and published as declared, the lifecycle at scale, the provenance benchmark, the three commands, what is not claimed, the record behind it
svg.title: quantum-cortex v1.1.0, the second edition: the record up to row 54, the provenance benchmark
svg.text: quantum-cortex v1.1.0, the second edition: the record up to row 54, the provenance benchmark
a small language model with a memory outside its weights, its limit measured; the numbers are in the notes under this figure,
every measured one a row's of docs/RESULTS.md, with the file that produced it and a test that recomputes it

g.text: a 27 million parameter byte level
language model, trained from scratch
by one researcher on a free GPU tier
and a laptop, plus an organ outside
the weights:
an append only journal of episodes,
sealed under a key;
every answer a citation of a stored
line by its pointer, or "no record";
the model decides, the organ answers;
an evicted address is withdrawn from
the memory and no longer returns;
built so that every claim about it has
a row, a file and a test that can fail

svg.text: What this edition establishes, from row 42 to row 54

g.text: The organ forgets exactly and keeps a history (rows 42 to 46)
an evicted address is withdrawn from the memory and no longer
returns, nothing kept moved; a changed value at one address is a
revision with its readable history, the past version never returned;
the index's buckets probed; an external model run through the
frozen prompt
The system holds on its own family of facts (rows 47 to 50)
under the adopted index geometry the right episode is retrieved on
every question and the four frozen conditions hold on the two seeds
that did not conceive the policy; a near duplicate written to the
journal is admitted under an identity rule and never cited in place
of the original under the adopted selection rule (R4)
The test the system failed, published as declared (rows 51, 52)
on sealed families of formulations the system had never seen, the
four frozen conditions hold on no cell: the model's own reading fails
on every cell, and the organ's mark alone selects the right line where
the model's does not; the simplest reference stacks are not separated
from the organ's at this size; the sentence for this outcome was
written before the run, and it is the one the row carries
The lifecycle at scale, read without the model (rows 53, 54)
on journals of eleven thousand and one hundred and ten thousand
entries, the withdrawal holds on every phase of every cascade; the
mark's guarantee against never planted names is measured to end at
these sizes, under the control's label; A0, the construction's own
ceiling under byte keys, is read with an instrument built for it

svg.text: For anyone's memory system: the provenance benchmark
a bench built from the sealed generator; your system's answers scored
with the record's reading and its frozen conditions, without the model
and without the organ; a measuring tool, not a leaderboard

g.text: pip install quantum-cortex
python -m cortex_c2b.companion_demo
python -m cortex_c2b.hm_protocol --persistent

svg.text: What this edition does not claim
that any of it holds at a larger size or on natural text; the read side brings no measured advantage over a classical stack on the sealed
families, and the write side's properties were compared with no reference; the limits are in the same table as the rest; not a product, not a chat model

g.text: every measurement declared before it ran, with the readings of every outcome; every file retained before a number in it was read;
the gravings of rows 49 to 54, the benchmark module and the figures read by committees of readers before they were committed; the failures published in the same table as the rest;
ten decision records, each opening with an original figure; the ideas register with its dated revisions; the paper, the first screen and the journey page with their figures;
code under Apache 2.0, documentation under CC BY 4.0; cite with CITATION.cff; the package quantum-cortex 1.1.0 on the Python index
established, each with a row, a file and a test
the failure and the limits, published as declared
what you can run
the record
